status: production backend request staging controller qualified; native whole-model integration/admission remains open

implementation.ownership: Embed controller metadata in a session resource owner; borrow its canonical resident request. Request owns all device buffers and pinned leases; destroy request before metadata at teardown. Cache is borrowed only for the submit call.
implementation.budget: Pure host query; metadata600 bytes on tested64-bit build. Two banks at128 raw rows/256cols reserve65536 pinned payload bytes and167936 device payload bytes. Cache/source/index, owner/request/event/context/allocator overhead separate; tests add device guard padding.
implementation.queue: Two pinned slots and three device planes per bank; fixed allocation at setup. Nonblocking acquire returns busy without LRU/I/O work. Cache gather and format-owned scale validation precede two H2D submissions and one decoder. Storage reads may block; no GPU completion wait inside submit.
implementation.epochs: Success publishes view+bank epoch only after all work is queued. Exact canonical-view current check rejects replaced, foreign and failed results. Callers enqueue consumers before reusing a bank and check final GPU completion separately. No model position/KV commit.
implementation.errors: Preflight/I/O/scale-domain rejection preserves prior epochs; cancels acquired leases. Backend errors poison all results. Failed setup after GPU resource changes requires discarding the unpublished request; partial allocations remain request-owned. Metadata free makes no GPU calls.
implementation.format: Quant-registry validate_scales callback owns finite nonnegative little-endian FP16 scale policy; scans all65536 scale words in synthetic tests. GPU view/cache/layout structs are named to permit forward declarations without public GPU-header dependencies.
implementation.metrics: Upload bytes count callbacks reporting successful enqueue, including successful planes before a later failure; not completed physical bytes. Batches/rows/epochs count successful decode submissions only.

tests.synthetic: Lower-layer cache fixture plus budget/metadata/init faults, overlap, two banks, epoch replacement, foreign request view, first/second acquire busy/error, cancel/lease errors, first/second upload failure, decode failure, I/O/domain retry recovery and teardown. Wrapped allocations cover init failures and zero linked hot allocation calls.
tests.actual: Real layer1/14 tables,32KiB/256KiB CPU cache budgets,two passes,72 reference-checked controller submissions;5384448 raw/BF16 bytes exact versus unchanged original Triton captures. Four additional unconsumed submissions are completed by real backend-session resource reset.
tests.precision: BF16 output unchanged; no FP16 projection adapter or whole Engram numeric equivalence claimed.

qualification.asan_scope: New staging controller and probe plus backend session teardown, cache/source/storage/JSON/platform and scalar scale validator; other quant objects and CUDA translation units are normal build. Allocation-wrapped unit exercises source/cache/stager allocation failures and zero linked hot allocations.
qualification.gpu_scope: 72 reference-checked controller submits plus4 unconsumed submissions finished by real session reset, for normal/ASAN/MEMCHECK/INITCHECK. Unchanged row kernel bounded36-call race unit, no whole-core/controller race run.

rows128.scope: Actual production staging submit with warmed code and managed-cache-cold rows. Two event queries are nonblocking lease acquisition; one caller completion outside controller. Test poison/readbacks outside ROI. Single raw-row samples, not full token workloads or matched latency comparisons.
